goal: Show converting a PDF to an editable Word (DOCX) file on PDFCraft: the page ready, add one PDF, press the convert button, and finish with the result and its download button visible. The tool is at /en/tools/pdf-to-docx and its button is labelled 'Convert to DOCX'. Conversion takes about 30 seconds in the browser, so wait for the 'Download' button with timeout_ms 60000 (a button whose name contains Download; match exactly one element). Do not open the downloaded file. If this URL is not the PDF to Word tool (404 or wrong page), start from https://pdfcraft.devtoolcafe.com/en/tools and open the tool whose title mentions converting PDF to Word.
facts: Chuyển PDF sang Word: chuyển tài liệu PDF sang định dạng Word (DOCX) để chỉnh sửa.
